thread:
maria: customer report — per-model throughput lines disappeared from Console around 2026-03-16 14:12 UTC. overall QPS still shows, but per-model breakdown is empty for ~40 models. customer org: fin-widget-prod.

maria: steps they ran: 1) open Console → Model throughput panel 2) change time range to 1h 3) see single total QPS line but no per-model series.

maria: attaching quick repro probe i ran against prometheus remote read for that org:
```
# promql: the dashboard uses: sum(rate(model_request_total[1m])) by (model_id)
sum(rate(model_request_total{org="fin-widget-prod"}[1m])) by (model_id)
```

maria: result: returns single series (no model_id label values) — metric exists but label empty.

alex: odd — exporter changed metadata recently? did we roll any exporter relabel configs or metric rewrite rules in the last deploy window?

maria: customer timeline: they saw it start at 14:12 UTC, matches our metric pipeline deploy at 14:10 UTC (rolling).

tim: can you curl the exporter on the affected host and paste a sample of raw metrics? need to see which labels are emitted.

maria: did that, here's the snippet from exporter /metrics at 14:18 UTC: 
```
# HELP model_request_total total requests per model
# TYPE model_request_total counter
model_request_total{org="fin-widget-prod",model_name="completion-XL",instance_id="i-0b12",} 12456
model_request_total{org="fin-widget-prod",model_name="chat-L",instance_id="i-0b13",} 2345
```

maria: note: exporter is emitting model_name not model_id (dashboard queries expect model_id).

ingrid: ah — we recently changed the model registry agent to rename the label to model_name (for human readability) and added a relabel step downstream, but it appears the normalization rule that maps model_name -> model_id for dashboards wasn't shipped to the metrics rewrite service.

tim: confirmation: prometheus relabel pipeline used to produce target_label=model_id from __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model_id. new agent switched pod label to model_name so relabel didn't match.

alex: short term workaround: in Grafana dashboard panels, change PromQL to fallback to model_name if model_id absent. e.g.:
```
# fallback pattern
label_replace(sum(rate(model_request_total[1m])), "model_id", "$1", "model_id", "(.+)") or sum(rate(model_request_total[1m])) by (model_name)
```

sre-oncall: or add a lightweight mapping rule in the metrics pipeline to copy model_name -> model_id until registry rollouts are consistent. I'll prepare a `metric-rewrite` patch we can hotfix.

maria: customer wants ETA for visible per-model graphs. they are in support tier standard — would like a fix in next 2 hours if possible.

ingrid: plan: 1) push patch to metrics-rewrite: if model_name exists and model_id missing, set model_id=model_name (non-destructive) 2) reload prometheus/remote-write config (no scrape changes) 3) reload dashboards to pick up label values. roll target: limited to hosted metrics cluster for org-blacklist none.

tim: I'll own the metrics-rewrite PR + rollout. patch ready in ~30m. once deployed, give it 5m for stale series to update then check dashboard.

maria: informing customer — will update when we confirm.

support-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03016-01 — per-model throughput missing due to metric attribute rename. severity: high (customer-facing graphs). Assigned: tim, ingrid.

sre-oncall: deployed a temporary mapping onto the staging metrics-rewrite and validated with a test org — mapping copies model_name->model_id. pushing to prod now.

maria: production patch applied at 14:42 UTC.

tim: verify: promql now returns series with model_id label again:
```
sum(rate(model_request_total{org="fin-widget-prod"}[1m])) by (model_id)
# returns multiple series: model_id="completion-XL", model_id="chat-L" ...
```

maria: customer confirms panels recovered at ~14:45 UTC. they reloaded Console and saw per-model lines return. :tada:

ingrid: follow-up: we'll add an integration test for label compatibility before model-registry-agent rollouts and a dashboard query shim for 48h after any model metadata change. also adding metrics schema migration notes to release checklist.

maria: closing support escalation with customer notified. will update internal postmortem if needed.

maria: final notes: root cause = model registry agent changed emitted attribute name to model_name but downstream rewrite didn't map it to the legacy model_id label that dashboards rely on. fix = hotpatch mapping + add release-time checks.
